description: This file implements security-related HTTP utilities, including IP deny list checks, URL validation, and secure HTTP/HTTPS request functions with redirect validation.

methods.name: getHttpDenyList
methods.description: Retrieves the HTTP deny list from environment variable or returns the default list.

methods.name: isDeniedIP
methods.description: Checks if an IP address is in the deny list and throws an error if it is.

methods.name: checkDenyList
methods.description: Validates a URL's hostname or IP against the deny list.

methods.name: secureAxiosRequest
methods.description: Performs an Axios request with redirect validation against the deny list.

methods.name: secureFetch
methods.description: Performs a fetch request with redirect validation against the deny list.

methods.name: resolveAndValidate
methods.description: Resolves a URL to an IP address and validates it against the deny list.

methods.name: createPinnedAgent
methods.description: Creates an HTTP or HTTPS agent that uses a specific IP address for requests.
